mapper.select: SELECT qc.id, qc.purchase_order_id, qc.sku_code, qc.length_cm, qc.width_cm, qc.height_cm, (qc.length_cm * qc.width_cm * qc.height_cm) AS volume_cm3, qc.gross_weight_kg, qc.net_weight_kg, qc.qc_file_id, sf.file_name AS qc_file_name, qc.remark, qc.create_by, qc.create_time, qc.update_by, qc.update_time FROM wms_purchase_order_qc_item qc LEFT JOIN sys_file sf ON qc.qc_file_id = sf.id WHERE qc.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY qc.create_time DESC
